title: Noor and the Portrait
author: Hazel Crane
blurb: Odile Montrose, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
